result.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
result.summary: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CarryOn，一个面向长时程智能体的「面向对象」上下文运行时：以可复用任务对象（continuation carriers）、互补执行上下文和近期交互尾部组成上下文视图，并在每次折叠时只针对绑定证据与环境校验修订受影响记录、前推未受影响记录，从而在不重建完整表示的前提下保持续接依据有效；在 OSWorld 2.0 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上报告了准确率提升与 token 消耗下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「持久任务状态 + 增量修订、避免全量重建」的上下文维护机制，可能为 LVR 中潜在推理状态的增量更新、工作区缓存与长度泛化提供可借鉴线索，可供核查是否存在可迁移的「证据绑定 + 局部修订」状态维护思路。
